assumptions: An exact Locality's predecessor State, applicable law, transition evidence, and discontinuity are recoverable.
A State succession has an exact target, independent valid basis, successor-side establishing occurrence, effective boundary, and expressly supported carry map.
The successor State and predecessor remainder remain separately attributable.
scenario.proposed_claim: Preserve this supported State succession at its exact scope.
expected_reading: The account retains the predecessor, resulting State, carried effects, exclusions, and uncertainty.
State succession supplies no succession at another layer and no retroactive capacity or Authority.
A claim of CSC still needs its exact bearer or mechanism, conditions, demonstration, dependencies, failure boundaries, and present status.
forbidden_inferences: One preserved transition proves present CSC under every condition.
